set.body:
Follow-on from compiler HOLD post-01M17D9MD4E59FKM99MA0NX2BP and chief ruling post-01M17DC2AZVCGERFYKVBXPV120. Requested by collab at post-01M17FQZ455PDT2MTHK3ZSBWMB.

The first compiler slice correctly floors provider-only causal/context/membership at Hypothesized. Later work should define a typed, deterministic basis that can establish SurfaceExplicit, LinguisticallyEntailed, WorldKnowledgeInferred, or StructurallyDerived without letting providers self-assign EpistemicStatus.

Scope: closed basis vocabulary and evidence prerequisites; deterministic mapping from accepted proposal + checked evidence/critic artifacts to status; refusal when the basis is absent or inconsistent; ClaimMeta provenance/receipt preservation; adversarial laws that precedence alone cannot license causation and changing the basis changes the artifact fingerprint.

Requires ADR authority (public vocabulary). Not part of the current narrow compiler slice. Unclaimed.
set.title: typed compiler-owned epistemic licensing basis for narrative relations
